description: This file defines the MyTimesheetAPI class, which extends EmployeeTimesheetAPI. It provides API endpoints and validation rules for handling employee timesheet data within the OrangeHRM system, including custom validation for the timesheet date parameter.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPI
classes.description: A class that handles API operations related to employee timesheets, including validation logic for creating, updating, and retrieving timesheet data.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving all timesheets, customizing parent rules.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new timesheet entry, including specific validation for the date parameter using custom rules.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a timesheet, customizing parent rules.
